title: KYA Scheme Descriptor v1
description: Off-chain descriptor referenced by IKYASchemeRegistry.Scheme.schemeURI. Holds the KYA principle; the chain holds only its address, hash, mode and verifier.

dimensions.description: Open vocabulary. Registered initial values: controller-binding, provenance, capability, accountability, behavioral, compliance, runtime-integrity.

levels.description: Map from level (decimal string 0-255) to semantics. Level 0 MUST be present and mean 'not verified / failed'.

erc8004Response.description: Value a KYA Bridge SHOULD mirror into the ERC-8004 Validation Registry for this level.

evidenceKinds.description: Open vocabulary. Registered initial values: erc8004-reputation, erc8004-validation, vc-jwt, vc-ld, tee-quote, zk-proof, domain-proof, payment-history.

issuerPolicy.description: Declares who may issue under this scheme. Declarative only — the framework does not enforce it.

publicInputLayout.description: Ordered names of ABI-encoded public inputs. MUST include subjectKey and nullifier. Canonical layout 'kya-public-v1': [subjectKey, nullifier, level, claimDigest, expiresAt, issuerSetRoot].

publicInputAbi.description: Solidity ABI types matching publicInputLayout, e.g. ["bytes32","bytes32","uint8","bytes32","uint64","bytes32"].
